data.company_overview: Postman is a collaboration platform for API development that lets teams design, test, document, and monitor APIs throughout their lifecycle. It is widely used by developers to streamline building and consuming APIs.
data.target_audience: Software developers and API teams building, testing, and managing REST, GraphQL, and other APIs.

data.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides a Postgres database, authentication, instant APIs, edge functions, and storage for developers building applications. It positions itself as a backend-as-a-service built on open-source tools.
data.target_audience: Developers building web and mobile applications who need a managed backend without vendor lock-in.
